requirement: SPEC.md section 7, shapes and their derived values
note: The maths of one path edge and of a whole path, asked of both engines. The comparison is exact because every answer here is built from the arithmetic number.javascript-arithmetic pins, and an arc answers in closed form rather than by sampling. The circle of two vertices and two bulges of one is the case the module header names: its area, length, centroid and bounds come from the true curve, so an engine that quietly sampled the arc would part from the other here.
